walkthrough.text: Sets up revolution volume integral $V = \pi \int_{1}^{3} \frac{1}{x(4 - x)}\,\mathrm{d}x$.
Decomposes integrand into partial fractions $\frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{4 - x}\right)$.
Evaluates across limits $1$ and $3$ to conclude $V = \frac{\pi}{2}\ln 3$.
